problem.passage:
Consider the system of equations shown.

y = -6x - 8
y = -6x - 7

How many solutions does the system of equations shown have?
problem.stimulus:
Consider the system of equations shown.

y = -6x - 8
y = -6x - 7
problem.question: How many solutions does the system of equations shown have?
problem.explanation: 두 식의 기울기가 -6로 같지만 y절편(-8 ≠ -7)이 달라 두 직선은 평행하고 만나지 않는다. 따라서 해가 없다.
problem.explanationEn: The two equations have the same slope (-6) but different y-intercepts (-8 ≠ -7), so the lines are parallel and never meet. So there is no solution.
